timing_caveat: Planning estimates, not promises. Include~2x measured training time plus data, checkpoint, implementation audit and telemetry margin. Threefold runs only on frozen fivefold quality success. No full-training wall-clock authority granted by this report.
decision: Technically feasible within measured hardware and disk headroom. Ready for review of the frozen paired design; do not start complete fits from this probe.
limitations: This is a self-designed RTD test, not a Q-FT reproduction.
A small-model resource probe says nothing about satisfaction AUC or whether5pretrain epochs suffice.
Historical validation reuse remains; threefold is a replication partition, not untouched data.
Numerical preprocessing/scalers and replacement donors for every complete arm must use only its own inner training set.
